final: WITH deltas AS (SELECT cs.constructorStandingsId, c.country, cs.wins - COALESCE(LAG(cs.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year, cs.constructorId ORDER BY r.round), 0) AS gained_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), country_avgs AS (SELECT country, AVG(gained_wins) AS avg_wins FROM deltas GROUP BY country), all_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_all FROM country_avgs), above_all AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, ca.avg_wins - am.mean_all AS excess_all FROM country_avgs ca CROSS JOIN all_mean am WHERE ca.avg_wins > am.mean_all), above_group AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_above FROM above_all), final_countries AS (SELECT aa.avg_wins, aa.excess_all, aa.avg_wins - ag.mean_above AS excess_above FROM above_all aa CROSS JOIN above_group ag WHERE aa.avg_wins > ag.mean_above) SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_final_country_avg_wins, AVG(excess_all) AS mean_excess_over_all_country_mean, AVG(excess_above) AS mean_excess_over_above_average_group_mean FROM final_countries
